# Ruturaj Chaubey

> Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications. Based in Pune, India.

Ruturaj Chaubey is a Full Stack Engineer at QED42, where he architects headless Drupal and Next.js solutions for enterprise clients including UNICEF and US-based organisations. He is an active Drupal community speaker and open source contributor.

- Email: ruturajchaubey16@gmail.com
- Location: Pune, India
- GitHub: https://github.com/RChaubey16
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/ruturajchaubey

## Skills & Technologies

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Python, PHP
Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
Backend: Node.js, NestJS, FastAPI, Drupal (headless/decoupled)
Databases & Infra: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker
CMS: Drupal, Sanity

## Experience

- Full Stack Engineer at QED42 — Architected headless Drupal + Next.js platforms for enterprise clients; led front-end for a UNICEF-affiliated product; mentored interns; delivered internal sessions on decoupled Drupal starter kits.
- Associate Engineer at QED42 — Built and maintained decoupled web applications; contributed to open source Drupal modules.
- Intern at QED42 — Learned Drupal development fundamentals and contributed to client projects.

## Work

- [Global EdTech Discovery Platform](https://www.ruturaj.xyz/work/edtech-discovery-platform) — Led the complete frontend build of a UNICEF-backed global EdTech discovery platform. Headless Drupal CMS paired with a Next.js frontend designed to surface expert-curated digital learning tools for educators, policymakers, and governments worldwide. Role: Lead Frontend Engineer at QED42.
- [Prette — Ecommerce Marketplace for Sewists](https://www.ruturaj.xyz/work/prette-ecommerce) — Built the full-stack integration layer for a Drupal Commerce-powered marketplace, connecting a Gatsby JS frontend to a headless Drupal backend via GraphQL — covering authentication, cart, wishlist, product pages, orders, and address management. Role: Full Stack Engineer at QED42.
- [Knowbase — Multi-Tenant Knowledge Base SaaS](https://www.ruturaj.xyz/work/knowbase) — Designed and built a multi-tenant knowledge base platform combining PostgreSQL full-text search with a fully async RAG pipeline (Jina AI + pgvector + Gemini) to let teams store, search, and query documents through keyword and AI-powered interfaces. Role: Solo Full Stack Engineer.

## Projects

- [Neuron](https://neuron.ruturaj.xyz/) — Shared backend platform exposing reusable services (URL shortener, queued templated email notifications) behind a single API key, with a dashboard for key management and per-key usage analytics. Source: https://github.com/RChaubey16/neuron
- [Roast My Drupal](https://roast-my-drupal.vercel.app/) — Paste a drupal.org username or profile URL and get roasted by an LLM using only public Drupal activity (bio, badges, maintained projects with release and issue health, contribution stats), in a comedic persona of your choice. A single Next.js API route scrapes, parses, caches, and streams the roast from Gemini alongside a live stats card. Source: https://github.com/RChaubey16/roast-my-drupal
- [What the Hex](https://what-the-hex.ruturaj.xyz) — Fast, minimal color lookup tool for developers and designers: paste a hex code, get the color name, preview, and ready-to-use CSS/SCSS variables. Source: https://github.com/RChaubey16/what-the-hex
